name: agentify
description: A committed-spec engineering lifecycle for Claude Code, and the plain-words reporting style that goes with it.

plugins.name: lifecycle
plugins.description: The full ticket-to-review lifecycle as callable skills: frame, grill, spec, plan, plan-check, deliver, ship and babysit, plus tdd, diagnose, resolve-conflicts and show, and the four sub-agents they dispatch. The session builds every task itself; fresh agents only review — risky tasks, UI screenshots, and the whole diff at the end. Optional review tiers put a signed-off walkthrough before the build and another after it. Type /advance and it runs whichever phase comes next. Reads how your repo works — gates, tracker, forge and ship mode, preview, naming, reviewers and the per-call effort budget — from nine files under .agents/, written by /onboard.

plugins.name: plain-words
plugins.description: Report in Simplified Technical English: small words, one idea per sentence, what you did, whether it worked, what to do now. Two options and a recommendation when a decision is needed. Strips the AI tells from everything that gets written, chat and committed documents alike: no em dashes, no filler, no puffery, plain words over fancy ones.
